title: Flat roof snow loads.
officialText: The flat roof snow load, ρ , on a roof with a slope equal to or less than 5 degrees (0.09 rad) (1 inch f per foot = 4.76 degrees) shall be calculated in accordance with Section 7.3 of ASCE 7.
